findings.conditions: mapped classifies no_reads by definition (zero expert reads) while this build's streamed path recorded expert_io_samples=0 (unmeasured), so the page-cache classes can never match and rerunning reproduces the exclusion; sweep record 1793270053899-35236-35; the memory block is valid: mapped peak is 1.52 GiB lower
findings.note: structurally unmeasurable by pairing on this build, not a performance verdict; the individually eligible runs read mapped ~69 against streamed ~45.6 decode tok/s and are a direction, not a number

findings.note: the sweep's own arms refused because auto resolved 64 slots and the batched routed prefill serves indices below 32 only; at the profile's recommended 16 slots the arm engages and wins, so the sweep is being re-armed to pin @16/streamed

mapped vs streamed decode: fix the expert-io sampler so streamed runs record a page-cache class (expert_io_samples stayed 0), then the residency sweep can pair; the 2026-10-29 direction read mapped faster by a third

mapped residency is refused together with the batched routed verify
the dense Humanizer install owes dense_kl, not moe_kl: the gate refuses the looser class
head_dim 512 on both attention shapes: the GQA-shared decode kernel (head_dim 128/256 only) cannot serve this family regardless of sinks, so its decode default stays barrier structurally
